exposure: Bakri balloon treatment for postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 60 patients who underwent Bakri balloon for PPH treatment from a total of 17,117 deliveries
finding: Bakri balloon treatment was successful in treating postpartum hemorrhage in 91.7% of patients.
gest_age: 47 patients were above the 34th gestational week, 13 patients were below the 34th gestational week
